title: Blind Discovery: Chicane Obstacle Traversal
goal_description: Discover control parameters enabling smooth traversal through chicane obstacles without timeout or collision.

hypotheses.title: Increase Tangential Gain to Enhance Turning
hypotheses.statement: By increasing the tangential gain, the robot will be more responsive to the turning required to navigate the chicane obstacles.
hypotheses.mechanism: The tangential gain affects the robot's ability to turn towards the goal, which is crucial in navigating tight turns.

hypotheses.title: Decrease Safety Margin to Improve Maneuverability
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to get closer to the obstacles, potentially enabling tighter turns and smoother traversal.
hypotheses.mechanism: A smaller safety margin means the robot will operate closer to the obstacles, which can improve its maneuverability in tight spaces.

titles: Increase Tangential Gain to Enhance Turning
Decrease Safety Margin to Improve Maneuverability
